assumptions: The current protocol remains frozen; literature practice motivates reporting, not new experiments or a universal equal-quality/FPR guarantee.
Numeric matched-quality calipers are pre-outcome design choices, not perceptual equivalence guarantees.
The study uses a deterministic consulted development cohort and no image outcome exists at this stage.
